pages.title: Scopa
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Scopa is an Italian card game where the cards you capture determine your score. Play from your hand to take a card of the same value or a group whose values add up to it. If you cannot capture anything, leave your card on the table. Clear the whole table with one capture to make a scopa.

Think about what each move leaves for your opponent. Collect cards from the coin suit, watch for the seven of coins called the settebello, and build a strong primiera to earn points at the end of the deal.

pages.title: Puzzle Jewels
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Puzzle Jewels asks you to draw through groups of matching pieces. Link at least three of the same kind to clear them, then look for another chain in the space that opens. Use keys to open locks and activate earned rewards to remove more pieces. Higher scores give you access to more rewards.

pages.title: 12 Minute Escape
pages.creator: 2Million Games
pages.description:
In 12 Minute Escape, you have twelve minutes to repair an ancient portal and get out. Fight slimes, gather magical materials and build structures that help you survive. Choose upgrades to prepare for tougher threats, including the Slime King.

Events such as Golden Rush, Treasure Hunt and Wizard Frenzy offer opportunities while the timer keeps running. Unlock new wizards as you play and see whether you can put the portal back together in time.

pages.title: Melon Drop: Fruit Merge Master
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Melon Drop: Fruit Merge Master gives you a container and a stream of fruit to drop into it. Bring two fruits of the same kind together to make a larger one. Choose where each piece lands so it can reach a match or leave room for a later drop. Keep merging toward bigger fruit without letting the pile overflow.

pages.title: Sweet Triple Mahjong
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Sweet Triple Mahjong asks you to remove candy tiles in groups of three. Select matching tiles that are free on the left or right. Look at which pieces will become available after a match, since clearing a group can uncover the ones you need next. Remove every tile to finish the board.

pages.title: Hypermarket 3D: Store Cashier
pages.creator: Sunday GmbH
pages.description: Hypermarket 3D: Store Cashier gives you a supermarket to run, with customers at the checkout and shelves to refill. Scan groceries at the register, stock the store and switch between jobs as the market gets busier. Some activities take you away from the counter, including cart-surfing challenges. Keep serving shoppers and build the store up from its smaller beginnings.

pages.title: Merge Heroes Titans
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Merge Heroes Titans puts you in command of melee fighters and archers. Combine the units you can buy to unlock stronger versions, then place them where their abilities can help against the next wave. Think about which enemies your close-range fighters can reach and where the archers can cover them. Win battles to discover more characters and worlds.

pages.title: Get To The Chopper
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Get To The Chopper is a first-person shooter where your way out is an extraction helicopter. Choose a primary gun, a secondary weapon, grenades and a melee weapon before taking on a mission. Fight the enemies between you and the helicopter as you cross areas such as forests and deserts. Reach the chopper to get out.

pages.title: Head Jump
pages.creator: atupdev
pages.description: Head Jump sends you through fast obstacle courses. Run, jump and climb to keep from colliding with the barriers in your way. Watch the shape of the next obstacle so you can decide which movement will get you past it. Finish each level to take on a more difficult route.

pages.title: Obby The Legendary Dragon
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Obby The Legendary Dragon sends you through different worlds to collect pets and develop your character. Catch pets in battle, hatch them from eggs and cases, or add to your team through purchases and trades. Earn money and improve your hero as you explore. New worlds, ranks and titles give you more to work toward as your team grows.

pages.title: Funny Walk Fail Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Funny Walk Fail Run turns walking into the main obstacle. Guide an unsteady character one step at a time as he stumbles through each course. Pay attention to where his feet and body are before taking another step. A move that looks simple can send him into a fall if the timing is off.

pages.title: Emoji Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Emoji Challenge gives you six kinds of puzzles built around emojis. Connect related symbols, test your memory or work out a word from a set of pictures. Other puzzles ask you to identify a shadow, recognize a cropped image or find the emojis that belong together. The clue changes with each mode.

pages.title: The Lost City - Match 3
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: The Lost City - Match 3 takes you through a series of gem puzzles. Line up three matching gems to clear them and use boosters to remove larger groups when the layout gets in your way. The stages have no timer, so you can study how a move will change the board before choosing it.

pages.title: Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter is a side-scrolling survival game set in a city overrun by zombies. Recruit survivors and leave the safe house to look for weapons, ammunition, food and medicine. Send teammates to different buildings to gather supplies or complete tasks. Decide where to go next while making sure the group can handle the zombies outside.

pages.title: Bffs Spring Break Fashionista
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Bffs Spring Break Fashionista puts you in charge of spring break outfits for Barbie and her friends. Look through the warm-weather clothes and pick skirts, dresses or other pieces for each girl. Try different combinations as you go. Give the friends coordinated outfits or choose a separate style for each one.

pages.title: Bus Stop Color Jam
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Bus Stop Color Jam asks you to send passengers to buses of the same color. Look at which passengers are available and choose who to move next. A full bus leaves for its destination, changing what you can do at the stop. Use power-ups when you need help sorting the remaining passengers. There are more than 400 levels to work through.

pages.title: Angry Chibi Run
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Angry Chibi Run sends a chibi runner down city routes with obstacles and oncoming trains. Jump or slide when a barrier blocks your path, and move aside when a train is coming toward you. Choose a character and customize their outfit before setting out. The run keeps going as long as you can avoid the hazards.

pages.title: Draw To Toilet - Line Drawing
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description: Draw To Toilet - Line Drawing asks you to guide boys and girls to their matching restrooms. Draw a route for each character and think about where their paths might meet. Two lines that look fine on their own can cause a collision once the characters start moving. Find paths that get everyone to the right door safely.

pages.title: Draw 2 Save - Stickman Rescue
pages.creator: Dinmo Games
pages.description: Draw 2 Save - Stickman Rescue gives you a stick figure to protect with a single line. Sketch a shield or shelter before threats such as swords, bullets or bombs reach him. The drawing becomes part of the scene, so its shape and position matter. Try a different design when your first defense leaves an opening.

pages.title: Box Run
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Box Run gives you a block to move through a board of tiles toward a destination. Roll it along the route and think about which squares it will cover after each move. Switches can change the layout, and some tiles can fall away. Find a way around the obstacles and bring the block to the end tile.

pages.title: Dodge Hero
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Dodge Hero sends a secret agent into a guarded vault. Dodge the security systems and guards, then use weapons you pick up to fight back. Watch the route for barriers while you move through the vault. The challenge is to react to the next obstacle before it stops your run.

pages.title: Fish eats a fish
pages.creator: winxland.ru
pages.description: Fish eats a fish starts you as a small fish feeding on plankton. Grow until you can go after larger prey, including predators that were dangerous at the start. Choose a survival run or play through the stages. In the latter mode, the fish keeps its growth as you progress and face more dangerous predators.

pages.title: Spider Hunt
pages.creator: tega game
pages.description: Spider Hunt asks you to stop a growing swarm of cockroaches by placing bombs. Each bomb takes time to explode. Watch the direction the insects are moving, then put the bomb where they are likely to pass when it goes off. Use the delay to your advantage and catch more of the swarm in the blast.

pages.title: Halloween Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Halloween Memory hides Halloween items under cards. Flip two cards and remember which pictures you saw, then use their positions to find a match later. Pair every card to finish the board before the time runs out. The symbols and layouts change as you move into more challenging levels.

pages.title: Red Ball
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Red Ball sends a red ball on a mission to save Christmas. Roll through the level and jump past obstacles or toward the enemies in your way. Watch what lies beyond each jump before you commit to it. Make it through the stages while taking on the enemies that threaten the holiday.

pages.title: Noob Button 2
pages.creator: Stickman vs Monster School Team
pages.description: Noob Button 2 tells a story about Noob and Pro one button press at a time. Press the button to see the next part of their adventure as it moves between the Normal World and Hell. The button advances the story, so you can read each part before moving on.

pages.title: Squid Survival
pages.creator: Vally Games
pages.description: Squid Survival is a game of Red Light, Green Light. Move while the light is green and stop as soon as it turns red. If you are spotted moving at the wrong time, you are eliminated. Watch for the signal to change as you cross the play area and try to reach the end.

pages.title: Draw Car Road
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Draw Car Road gives you a yellow car that needs a bridge to reach a red flag. Draw a path that lets the car cross the uneven terrain and get onto the finishing platform. Look at the height of each side before drawing. A route has to connect the ground the car starts on with the place it needs to reach.

pages.title: Ninja Man
pages.creator: SNSHUB
pages.description: Ninja Man challenges you to cross gaps by stretching a stick into a bridge. Judge the distance to the next platform before you stop extending it. If the stick is too short, the ninja will fall while crossing. Each landing gives you a new gap to measure, so adjust the length for the next platform.

pages.title: Draw Race io
pages.creator: Nevar Games
pages.description: Draw Race io lets you steer a car by drawing the path you want it to follow. Aim the route at rival cars and try to push them into the water. Collect coins where you can without putting your own car too close to the edge. Draw a new line when you need to change direction.

pages.title: Crazy Golfish
pages.creator: Podge Games
pages.description: Crazy Golfish plays like golf with a fish in place of the ball. Aim each shot toward the bowl and try to reach it in as few strokes as you can. Spikes and circular saws can cut the attempt short, while toilets send the fish off course. Look at where the fish could land before taking the next shot.

pages.title: Tomb of The Cat Color
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Tomb of The Cat Color gives a cat ten seconds to collect the coins and escape from a cemetery. The cat paints the ground as it moves, but the coins are what matter for clearing the level. Choose a route that reaches each pickup quickly. There are 20 stages to get through.

pages.title: Ludo Kingdom Online
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Ludo Kingdom Online gives you three ways to play Ludo. Choose Vs Bot for a game against the computer, use Online to be matched with other players, or start a Private game with friends. Share the private code so they can join the same match. Roll and move your pieces around the board as you try to bring them home.

pages.title: Parkour Block 3
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Parkour Block 3 challenges you to jump across block platforms and reach the portal at the end of each course. Use WASD to move, Space to jump and Left Shift to run. Take care around gaps over lava, and watch the timing of moving platforms. A running jump can help when the next block is farther away.

pages.title: Light It On
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description: Light It On gives you puzzles about switching lights on and off. Look at which lights the level asks you to control, then use the switches and other pieces in the setup. Pay attention to what each action changes before you make the next move. The goal is to leave the lights in the required state.

pages.title: Princess Rivalry
pages.creator: Top Girl Games
pages.description: Princess Rivalry puts you in charge of styling Elsa and Rapunzel, who both want to impress the same person. Choose their hairstyles, then mix tops and bottoms to build an outfit for each princess. Finish with accessories such as sunglasses or a necklace. See how their rivalry turns out after both looks are ready.

pages.title: Street Dunk
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Street Dunk gives you a basketball and a hoop to aim for. Set up a shot and watch the arc to see whether it reaches the basket. Use Training mode to get a feel for the throws, then try Highscore mode to see how many points you can earn.

pages.title: trezeBoost
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: trezeBoost asks you to climb by boosting from one platform to the next. Aim your boost at a spot you can land on and watch where the next jump will take you. Missing a platform and falling resets the score. See how high you can get before a jump goes wrong.

pages.title: Billiard Neon
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Billiard Neon lets you play pool against another player or the computer. Aim to pocket your balls while keeping an eye on the 8-ball, which can end the match if you sink it at the wrong time. Think about where the cue ball will stop so you have a useful position for the next shot.

pages.title: tankroyale.io
pages.creator: SakiGames
pages.description: In tankroyale.io, you drive a small tank into battles against other tanks. Use the terrain to stay out of enemy fire while looking for a chance to shoot back. Earn cash to change your weapons, hull or engine. Invite friends to a battle or join a multiplayer match and see how long you can keep your tank in play.

pages.title: Impostor Zombrush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Impostor Zombrush sends a little impostor through a world of blocks while other characters chase it. Jump between platforms, avoid hazards and make it to the goal before they catch you. Pick up coins along the way to unlock more characters. Watch for gaps as you decide when to jump.

pages.title: Red and Green 2 Candy Forest
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Red and Green 2 Candy Forest follows a red character and a green character through ten chapters designed for two players. Collect candy to earn points and watch for lasers along the way. Keep track of both characters as you work through each course together, especially when a hazard lies between one player and the next pickup.

pages.title: Santa Weightlifter
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Santa Weightlifter asks you to keep Santa balanced on a platform. Click or tap when he needs a correction and keep making adjustments as his balance changes. Staying upright earns points. The game speeds up as you continue, so watch Santa's position and be ready to respond sooner on the next move.

pages.title: Little Princess Dentist Adventure
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Little Princess Dentist Adventure begins when Anna's teeth start to hurt and Elsa takes her to the dentist. Play the dentist in the game's clinic and work through the activities to help Anna. Use the tools as the appointment progresses and finish the treatment so she can leave the clinic.

pages.title: Dodge The Tower
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Dodge The Tower starts with a jump from a tower and turns into a race to the finish. Keep moving toward the end and pick up perks along the way. Some increase your speed, while others freeze opponents and give you a chance to get ahead. Use those openings to make up ground before the finish.

pages.title: True or False Challenge
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: True or False Challenge gives you statements and asks you to decide which are accurate. Read each claim and choose True if it is correct or False if it is wrong. The quiz moves between different topics, so check the wording before choosing. A detail in the statement can change the answer.

pages.title: Classic Muscle Cars Jigsaw Puzzle 2
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Classic Muscle Cars Jigsaw Puzzle 2 gives you eight pictures of muscle cars to put back together. Pick a picture and choose a grid of 2 by 3, 3 by 4 or 4 by 6 pieces. Drag each piece into place. Look for details such as a curve of bodywork or the edge of a tire to help find the fit.

pages.title: Running Races 3D
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Running Races 3D gives you running courses with platforms and obstacles to clear. Click the left mouse button to jump and click again when you need a double jump. Look at the distance to the next landing before taking off. The routes change across levels, so adjust the timing to suit the course in front of you.

pages.title: Real Jungle Animals Hunting
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Real Jungle Animals Hunting puts you in a forest with animals to find and track. Move with WASD or the arrow keys and use the right mouse button to zoom in on a target. Press R to reload and Q to switch weapons. Look through the trees and across open ground for a clear view before aiming.

pages.title: Zombie Killer Truck Driving
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Zombie Killer Truck Driving puts you in a monster truck trying to get home on Halloween night. Drive through the zombies and pick up money to upgrade the truck. Use W and S or the Up and Down arrows to move, and A and D or the Left and Right arrows to rotate the truck.

pages.title: Sisters Dream Wedding
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Sisters Dream Wedding has Mia and Bella getting married on the same day at separate venues. Choose makeup, wedding outfits and accessories for both sisters, then decide where each ceremony will take place. Decorate the two spaces to suit the looks you picked. You can give each wedding a different style.

pages.title: Boy Doll Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Boy Doll Coloring Book gives you drawings of boy dolls to color. Pick a page and choose how to color the character and the details around him. Try different shades for separate parts of the picture, or repeat a color to tie them together. Switch drawings when you want another design to work on.

pages.title: Vikings vs Skeletons
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Vikings vs Skeletons is a side-scrolling adventure across six levels. Fight the skeletons and other monsters in your way while collecting stars and hearts. Look ahead as you move through the platforms so you can reach the pickups without running into an enemy. Make it through each stage to continue the adventure.

pages.title: Mosaic Puzzle Art
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Mosaic Puzzle Art asks you to build pictures by placing colors onto a field. Click a color and apply it to the part of the design where it belongs. Use the reference pattern to see how neighboring colors fit together. Fill in the remaining areas to finish the picture before choosing another mosaic.

pages.title: Blocky Wars Advanced Combat SWAT Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Blocky Wars Advanced Combat SWAT Multiplayer puts you in online firefights in a block-style world. Choose Deathmatch to take on individual opponents or Team Deathmatch to fight alongside a team. Join matches with friends or other players. Keep track of where opponents are moving as you look for an opening to shoot.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Master Racing Game 2020
pages.creator: zuma studio
pages.description: Bike Stunt Master Racing Game 2020 puts you on a motorcycle on tracks high above the ground. Follow the route, take the jumps and get to the finish. Pay attention to where a ramp sends the bike so you can prepare for the landing. The tracks range from easier trials to routes that demand more precise handling.

pages.title: Driving Ball Obstacle
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Driving Ball Obstacle challenges you to guide a ball through different routes. Hold the mouse button to get the ball moving, then judge when to advance past each obstacle. Look at the layout before the next stretch. Each level gives you another arrangement of barriers to navigate before you can reach the end.

pages.title: Back to School Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Back to School Puzzle gives you six school-themed pictures to put together. Pick an image and choose a puzzle with 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces. Find fragments that share part of the same object or background and use them to build up the picture. Try a larger piece count for a more detailed puzzle.

pages.title: Valentines Cards Match
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Valentines Cards Match hides pairs of Valentine's pictures on a board. Click a card to see its image and remember where it is. When you uncover the same picture again, return to the card you saw earlier to make a match. Pair every card to clear the board and work through all 15 levels.

pages.title: Nurse Kissing
pages.creator: Gamer Games
pages.description: Nurse Kissing asks you to help a patient and a nurse share a kiss without the doctor noticing. Use the mouse or touch controls when the doctor is looking away, then stop when attention turns back to the couple. Make use of the quiet moments before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Mr Bow
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Mr Bow puts you in archery fights against enemy stickmen. Choose a bow and arrows, aim toward a rival and fire when the shot is lined up. Watch where the arrow lands and adjust your aim for the next one. The goal is to take out the enemy archers before they defeat you.

pages.title: Coffee Break Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Coffee Break Memory hides coffee-themed pictures under a set of tiles. Click or tap to turn tiles over, then use what you remember to find their matching partners. Pair every picture to finish the board. There are four levels, and the challenge is to complete each one in as few turns as possible.

pages.title: Police Flying Car Simulator
pages.creator: gamesfog
pages.description: Police Flying Car Simulator lets you take a police car into the air for missions. Chase a thief, follow a celebrity or collect points, depending on the objective you are given. Earn cash to unlock more vehicles. Check what the mission asks for before taking off so you know where to fly next.

pages.title: Tap & Click The Zombie Mania Deluxe
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Tap & Click The Zombie Mania Deluxe challenges you to stop zombies by tapping or clicking them. Watch for the next group as they appear and take them out to add to your score. Keep looking around the play area as you finish one target so you can react to the next one.

pages.title: Chipolino
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Chipolino is a running and jumping game about keeping your character on the move. Jump over obstacles and collect the blood pickups along the route to extend the run. Look at where the next obstacle is before jumping so you can judge when to take off. Try to make it farther on the next attempt.

pages.title: Merge Blast
pages.creator: FluffyFoxGames
pages.description: Merge Blast gives you colored balls to aim and fire. Shoot at one of the same color to merge them into a larger ball. Once a ball grows big enough, it bursts. Choose where to shoot so you can build toward the next burst, and collect coins to buy new balls.

pages.title: Ocean Voyage With Bff Princess
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Ocean Voyage With Bff Princess gets Mia, Emma and Bella ready for a trip at sea. Choose an outfit for each friend and add accessories to go with the clothes. Try different combinations as you prepare the three looks. You can keep a theme across the group or give each friend a different style for the voyage.

pages.title: Scary Faces Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Scary Faces Jigsaw starts you with one picture to assemble and opens another when you complete it. Work through twelve pictures of scary faces. Choose an easy puzzle with 25 pieces, a medium one with 49, or a hard one with 100. Match features or background details to find where each fragment goes.

pages.title: Knife Dart
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Knife Dart asks you to throw knives into a piece of tree bark without hitting knives already stuck in it. Wait for an empty spot before each throw. The openings get harder to use as the challenge continues, so watch the target closely. Earn coins to unlock new knives and try to improve your score.

pages.title: Top Burger Cooking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Top Burger Cooking puts you behind the counter filling customer orders. Check which ingredients belong in each burger and assemble them with the mouse. Watch the customer's timer while you get the food ready. Work through the levels or choose Time Attack to see how much you can serve before time runs out.

pages.title: Basketball Arcade
pages.creator: oneru220
pages.description: Basketball Arcade asks you to sink shots from different distances before the timer runs out. Choose a team, then line up each throw and adjust to where you are standing on the court. Get as many balls through the hoop as you can and see how high a score you can set.

pages.title: Cool Cars Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Cool Cars Differences gives you two pictures of an old car and a time limit to find what changed. Compare the same parts of both pictures and select each difference. A faster finish earns a better score. Use the Hint button if you cannot spot one of the remaining changes.

pages.title: EG Duck Hunter
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Duck Hunter asks you to hit ducks before they fly off the screen. Move the scope onto a bird and fire while it is still in view. Watch the direction it is flying so you can get the scope into position before it gets away. Then line up the next duck as it comes into range.

pages.title: Neon Slimes
pages.creator: Paradine
pages.description: Neon Slimes is a duel where the aim is to make the other slime fall. Jump onto your opponent's head to make them smaller and weaker. Use a double jump to change your approach or reach a higher position before landing. Watch where the other slime is moving so you can land the next hit.

pages.title: Highway Racer 3D
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Highway Racer 3D puts you in a car on a highway full of traffic. Steer with the Left and Right arrows to get around other vehicles. Choose One Way, Two Way or Time Attack to change the drive, or try the Speed Bomb mode. Each mode has a best score to improve on later runs.

pages.title: Agent Smith
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Agent Smith lets you take on randomly selected missions or roam in Explore mode. Fight enemies with guns and grenades, use vehicles to move around, and visit the shop for perks. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move, Space to jump and the left mouse button to fire. Throw a grenade with the right mouse button when you need a different attack.

pages.title: Space Hoops
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Space Hoops is a basketball shooting game set in space. Aim your throw to send the ball through the hoop. A clean basket earns a bigger multiplier, so adjust your aim to keep the shot clear of the rim. Power-ups can change the conditions, including making the basket larger.

pages.title: Mahjong King
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description: Mahjong King gives you a collection of tile layouts to clear by finding matching pairs. Look for tiles you can select and choose a match that frees up more pieces underneath or beside it. Use power-ups when you need help with a layout, or try the daily puzzle for a separate challenge.

pages.title: Bonnie Follow Me To
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Bonnie Follow Me To follows Bonnie and her boyfriend on a month of travel. Style Bonnie for the photos she wants to take along the way. Put together a look and see how it appears in the finished picture. Each photo is a chance to capture a different stop on the trip.

pages.title: Retro Speed: Extreme Racing Challenge
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Retro Speed: Extreme Racing Challenge puts you in a car that keeps picking up speed. Pass the cars in front of you and collect coins to raise your score. Faster driving leaves less time to move around traffic, so watch for a gap before changing your position. Keep overtaking for as long as you can.

pages.title: Pixel Battle Royale Multiplayer
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Pixel Battle Royale Multiplayer drops you into a blocky battleground where the goal is to be the last player alive. Stay alert as you move through the map and take on other players. You can also pick Deathmatch or Team Deathmatch for a different kind of fight, or try Explore mode.

pages.title: Brick Breaker Galaxy Defense
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Brick Breaker Galaxy Defense puts a spaceship in the role of the paddle. Guide it across the screen to return the ball and send it into the bricks. Look for angles that reach the pieces still standing after a few hits. Keep the ball in play until you clear the formation.

pages.title: Speed Rush
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Speed Rush is a lap race where track hazards can cost you time. Drive around cones and mud when you have room, and keep off the oil so the car does not lose control. Watch for hazards as you approach a corner. The goal is to finish the laps in as little time as possible.

pages.title: Boho Winter with Princess
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Boho Winter with Princess lets you redesign a room and choose winter outfits for Elsa and Snow White. Start with the room and give it a bohemian look. Then browse the wardrobe for pieces to layer, including knits, leather, fur and tall boots. Coordinate the pieces to create a different winter look for each princess.

pages.title: Denim Hairstyles
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Denim Hairstyles has you prepare Jenny's hair to go with her denim outfits. Wash it before choosing a style from her catalog. Some styles involve dyeing the hair, while others have you work through the steps of making a braid. Choose a finished hairstyle to go with the denim shirt or dress.

pages.title: Plumber Puzzle
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Plumber Puzzle gives you pieces of pipe to arrange so water can flow through the layout. Turn the pieces to join their open ends, and look for gaps that break the connection. Check the route before the timer runs out. Complete the plumbing to clear the level and move on to the next layout.

pages.title: Fidget Spinner Master
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Fidget Spinner Master gives you a spinner to set in motion. Keep spinning and collect the coins you earn, then spend them on a different spinner. Try another design once you have enough to buy one. The game follows a simple loop of spinning, collecting and adding to your spinner collection.

pages.title: Snap the Shape: Japan
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Snap the Shape: Japan gives you a grid and a set of shapes to fit into it. Drag the pieces onto the board and work out how their edges fit together. Move a piece again if it leaves a gap you cannot fill. Complete the layout to continue through the puzzles set among spring cherry blossoms.

pages.title: Princess Magazine Winter Edition
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Magazine Winter Edition asks you to style a princess for a magazine shoot. Create three looks for the winter issue using dresses, sweaters and other wardrobe pieces. Pick shoes and accessories such as hats or scarves to finish the outfits. Give each look its own combination before the photo session.

pages.title: Eliza Christmas Night
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Eliza Christmas Night gets Eliza and her house ready for Christmas Eve. Choose an outfit for the celebration, then decorate the room while she waits for Santa. Try different combinations in the wardrobe and in the house. The two stages let you decide what Eliza wears and how the space will look.
